newsitem.title: USA: Transworld Home acquires two businesses. [CORRECTED 17:12 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Transworld Home acquires two businesses. [CORRECTED 17:12 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to show Transworld Home bought segments of the two companies, not the whole companies)
Transworld Home HealthCare Inc said on Monday it has completed the acquisition of the home infusion therapy business of U.S. HomeCare Corp.
It also has acquired certain assets and liabilities of Health Meds Inc, a Quincey, Fla., respiratory mail-order pharmacy. Terms were not disclosed.
U.S. HomeCare, based in Hartford, Conn.
